faqItems.question: What should I bring to my first appointment?
faqItems.answer: Please bring your ID, insurance information, and any relevant medical history records to ensure a smooth check-in process.

faqItems.question: How often should I visit the dentist?
faqItems.answer: We recommend regular dental check-ups every six months to maintain optimal oral health, though this may vary based on your individual needs.

faqItems.question: Is the clinic good for children?
faqItems.answer: Yes! We specialize in nurturing generations of smiles and are highly recommended for kids, ensuring they feel comfortable and safe.

faqItems.question: How can I book an appointment?
faqItems.answer: You can schedule your path to a perfect smile by calling us directly at (651) 633-1311 or using our effortless online booking tool.

faqItems.question: Why is regular preventive care important?
faqItems.answer: Regular visits help prevent tooth decay, protect against gum disease, and strengthen your teeth so you can enjoy a healthy smile for life.

faqItems.question: What are your office hours?
faqItems.answer: We are open Monday through Thursday from 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM, with specialists available on Fridays by appointment only.

clinic.footerAbout: Long Lake Family Dentistry has been serving residents of New Brighton for over 30 years, providing expert dental care with a personal touch and state-of-the-art technology.

doctor.name: Hossein Jalali
doctor.bio: Dr. Hossein Jalali has provided exceptional dental care to families in New Brighton and the surrounding area for over 30 years. He graduated with honors from The University of Minnesota School of Dentistry in 1988, where he also held a faculty position as an Associate Professor. As the founder of Long Lake Family Dentistry and a Platinum Plus Invisalign provider, Dr. Jalali is dedicated to combining innovation with a personal touch to help every patient smile brighter.
